The '''Prospector's Riot''' occurred when the crew of the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' were besieged by buyers who wanted their money back for the worthless [[Mini-Huvicko/Yuzabi Dowser binary hydromech droid|M-HYD droids]] they had bought.
